acceptance.composition: no operand radius, published row, retained state, verification or certificate enters the proof; the combination's rows are its own solve on the prepared stiffness and are not the factor-weighted sum of its operands' published rows; operand cases keep their values, evidence, cache snapshots and standing
acceptance.final: direct error certificate of the actual frozen raw and SI values against both physical readouts; unchanged absolute bound, two sharper predicates, raw/SI decimal checks, scale/class/zero/small-scale rules, G5a and observable guards
scoped_cross_references: D2 section4.11.2 historical operational-convergence warrant for b
D2 section5 I-9 historical formed-at-p magnitude description
acceptance.standing: G0-G8 remain ordered; pre-S-I absolute/not_covered row and headline binding stays refused; no S-I activation, private interval export or exact-profile guarantee change
acceptance.warrant: Native p/P stops are native operational convergence only. For this registered formation the final b and relative allowances are independently checked by the direct final certificate; this replaces historical native-formation warrant wording only for these final rows.

lanes.admitted_k: exact admitted products E*A,G*J,E*Iz,E*Iy of the representative source's members and exactly zero coefficient differences; actual common frame and support law; loads per lanes.loads
lanes.annular_seed: same-draft admitted_k global displacement/rotation midpoint RN1024(lo+hi)/2; exact prescribed coordinates; complete owner/DOF/unit/data binding
lanes.annular_source: directed1024 annulus geometry; base/point E,G are exact lifts; interpolated material encloses the affine normalized endpoint interpolation and actual selected E_hat/G_hat; use its coefficients in both residual and recovery
lanes.loads: each loaded DOF's exact combined net N_g (the owner's K4LED: every operand term's exact product c_i*v_ij, summed exactly per DOF) enclosed outward at 1024 bits as [RD1024(N_g),RU1024(N_g)], in free residual rows and constrained reaction offsets; prescribed coordinates exact zero; data flags from each individual product (c_i!=0 and v_ij!=0), never from a net, so an exactly cancelled net stays data; the enclosure never takes an operand's individual terms, a binary64 product or a rounded net
lanes.owner: the combination's recorded selected run (NativeOwner::Combination), its K4CMB source and combined ledger, its cache (imports from selected operands plus its own builds) and one nonreused proof anchor
lanes.per_lane: fresh residual and alpha check; zero or one existing verification-factor correction when data exists; fresh final residual/radius and complete recovery; zero-Delta work still counted
lanes.reuse: project and certify the same stored lane results; no extra residual call

preparation.operands: every operand source is a prepared source of operand_definition: a selected or unavailable operand through its case ProductAttempt's preparation (retained_precision_preparation_v1), a not_required operand through one OperandPreparation (retained_precision_operand_preparation_v1); RP-PREPARED-ANNULUS-v1 unchanged

H: raw=RN1024(m*1000) for mm; RN1024(m/1000000) for MPa; otherwise m
y=RN64(raw), retain actual Normal/Subnormal/Underflow/Overflow result before branching
Normal/Subnormal preserve actual nonzero; zero canonicalizes to +0; Underflow becomes +0 with loss retained by final distance test; Overflow refuses
n=RN64(y/1000) for mm; RN64(y*1000000) for MPa; otherwise y

rows.ancillary: none: a mechanics combination publishes no mode, parity or modulus record
rows.component_stress: directed signed-corner N/A,My/Z,Mz/Z,T*c/J before H; admitted-K bending Z is hull(actual Z,I_K/c); source uses own denominators
rows.coverage: exactly the combination's own final rows: 6n displacement components (constrained ones input-derived +0), n displacement magnitudes, 12m end actions and 18m station actions, 20m signed stresses, 6g signed support components and 2g support magnitudes over its g attributed supports (7n+50m+8g); derivative slots 0-19 of every member required and slot 20 empty; no record required; a missing, duplicated or extra row fails the whole proof
rows.displacement_magnitude: finish the same node's frozen global_nodal_displacement_x/y/z rows; RN64, ties to even, of the exact 3-norm sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2) of their frozen raw values (mm): each square and their sum formed exactly, the square root rounded once to binary64, the same bits on every platform; finite only (a norm beyond binary64's range refuses the row), canonical +0, SI by the projection's mm rule; formed in the kernel's projection for combination owners only; still certify dual physical norm and the unchanged 64-epsilon combination magnitude guard (base G7 combination_magnitudes), which the observables stage checks; not H of a lane norm hull and not a nested binary64 hypot
rows.maximum: not published: no combination maximum (COMBINATION_STRESS_MAXIMUM_UNAVAILABLE) and no intensified row
rows.prescribed: exact zero prescription of every operand term, so the combined prescription is exactly +0; prescribed classification, raw/SI equality
rows.support_magnitude: finish same-support authenticated Fx/Fy/Fz or Mx/My/Mz slots; binary64 hypot(hypot(x,y),z), finite nonnegative and canonical +0; still certify dual physical norm and unchanged 64-epsilon component guard

scope.operand_equality: equal K4STF bytes, layout, stations and supports (kernel OperandsDiffer) and equal prepared section facts across all operands and the combination: material basis, the selected material operands of every member bit for bit, normalized D, effective wall and the prepared A,I,J,Z,c bits of every member, as the operands' preparations and CaseSource section_terms state them
scope.operand_sources: selected operand: its selected solve (cache imports allowed); unavailable operand with a CaseSource: that registered source, rebuilt and K4SRC-identity-checked (no import); not_required operand: the one registered OperandPreparation source shared by every combination that requests it (no import); no operand is solved, mutated or re-prepared for a combination
scope.scope_limit: These are this formation's limits, not permission to omit other promised F2a routes or protected cases.
scope.trigger: a mechanics combination that the T0R gates admit, whose terms name distinct load cases, at least one of them selected after T-9; its group is the first selected operand's and its representative source is operand 0's

stages.aliases: completes with no headline alias: headlines cover load cases only
stages.observables: base G7 combination_magnitudes on the frozen rows: one support-action row per support and component, and each displacement, force and moment magnitude p with |p-r| <= 64*eps*max(|p|,MIN_POSITIVE), r the binary64 hypot(hypot(x,y),z) of the same combination's published components; the case support coverage and guard; no preview case evidence, maximum or headline check; a failure is this combination's facade_certificate

trust.G7: unchanged projected preview base evidence validator
trust.G8: independent invocation/model/material/normalized-input/map rederivation; the combination expression (case ids and factor bits in authored order) equal to the invocation's; each operand CaseSource rederived as a case's; K4CMB recomputed from the operands' K4SRC bytes and factor bits and bound to kernel_source_sha256 with one common K4STF; scope.operand_equality; checked source/preparation associations; the combined ledger bound by ledger_sha256 as attestation; no historical physics-source stress recipe
trust.attestation: digests bind facts but do not prove producer origin, solve, actual lane execution or rounded preparation
trust.validation: independent Rust replay and producer review validate algorithm/custody on exact implementation; Python/TS do not replay private proofs

work.additional_product: entered lanes/projection/conversion/comparison/adapter/maximum-completion work separately retained with actual status and failed prefixes; combined-net enclosures counted as add entries; no preparation; no all-in LME total or new price
work.auxiliary: unqualified library/internal work remains explicitly auxiliary; capacity evidence is not an RSS or aggregate allowance
work.finalization: complete public identity/receipt/diagnostic/certificate/hash/resource transaction required after private proof
work.native_meter: C1/C2 physical/logical partition and recorded native debit unchanged; the combination's own Run on the invocation's one meter under its own 20B case limit
